critical_code_review_comments: Backend generate-full admin bypass at server.py ~L6560 is intentional per owner — do not change (owner explicitly wants admin to be able to force-generate). The fix is correctly frontend-only: ReportPage.jsx auto-gen effect (~L1733) and display unlock (~L2049) now depend ONLY on report.is_paid || report.manually_unlocked (viewer role no longer matters).

GET /api/admin/users segment='premium' now correctly requires a payment_transactions doc with payment_status='paid' — this fixes the prior bug where admin-granted or subscription-only users were incorrectly labeled premium.
Admin confirm dialog copy is clear and explicitly warns 'no payment will ever be collected, and the user will appear as GRANTED' — good UX guard against accidental clicks.
server.py continues to be very large (>10000 lines). Consider modularizing admin endpoints, report endpoints, and payment endpoints into separate routers — not blocking, purely maintainability.

rca of the issue: Original prod bug: ReportPage.jsx computed `unlocked = report.is_paid || report.manually_unlocked || (user?.role === 'admin')`. That meant when an admin opened a free user's unpaid report, the page treated it as unlocked and the auto-generate useEffect fired POST /api/reports/{id}/generate-full — burning Gemini tokens silently. Fix (verified): remove the role check from the frontend unlock computation and from the auto-generate guard, so the admin now sees the locked FreePreviewLanding view (no auto-fire), but the backend admin bypass remains for explicit admin actions.
